title: App Platform Accessibility in Cloud Panel

updates.body:
Between 16:40 UTC and 18:22 UTC, our Engineering team observed an increase in 4xx error rates with App Platform operations via the Cloud Control Panel. During this time, users may have experienced errors while attempting to view or update their apps on the Cloud Panel. This was a UI-only issue and apps continued to run throughout the duration of the incident.

Our Engineering team has resolved this issue. As of 18:22 UTC, users should no longer be experiencing this issue and all services should now be functioning normally.

We apologize for any inconvenience, and if you are still experiencing any problems or have additional questions, please open a Support ticket within your account.
